Barsealona by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Barsealona is where your Seagrove Beach getaway goes from good to legendary. Spring break, summer vacay, or just because, this spot puts you right in the middle of 30A’s best, from the laid-back charm of Grayton Beach to the sleek vibes of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Inside, the open living space is bright, breezy, and ready for anything. Movie nights, game days, or just kicking back with a good book (or a great cocktail). The kitchen?

Fully stocked for everything from beach-day fuel to a full-blown seafood feast. Out back, the private pool is practically begging for a cannonball contest. Fire up the grill for a sunset cookout, lounge with a drink in hand, or make a splash or three in the pool. A poolside bathroom and laundry setup mean no soggy treks through the house. Because vacation should be easy. Want to explore? Hop on a bike and cruise the Timpoochee Trail, browse Seaside’s quirky shops, or hit the beach for sun, sand, and serious relaxation. For the best in food, fun, and beachy vibes, 30A delivers. With Oversee 30A, you’re in good hands. Our local team is always close by, ready to help seven days a week (plus a 24/7 emergency line for the truly unexpected). Let’s make this trip one for the books. Overview: - 860 steps (.4 miles) to the beach (San Juan Public Beach Access) - 5 bedroom, 5 bath - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog - 3744 sq ft - Saltwater pool - (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Gas grill - Wi-Fi included - 5 bikes included Overnight: THIRD FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared hall bath, TV - Guest Room: Three twin singles, shared hall bath, TV - Guest Bunkroom: Two twin over twin bunks, shared hall bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is at 10:00 AM CST.
